task_completion.description: The agent locates and opens the source data file at ~/pebl/data/flanker_rt_data.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor showing the contents of flanker_rt_data.csv with columns for participant ID, condition, and reaction time.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies participants with data quality issues or applies RT-based exclusion criteria.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or logs showing the identification of 'excluded' participants or filtering logic based on protocol violations/RT thresholds.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates mean reaction times for congruent, incongruent, and neutral conditions for each valid participant.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Calculations, code output, or a dataframe showing mean RTs grouped by participant and condition.

task_completion.description: The agent computes the interference score (Incongruent RT - Congruent RT) for each valid participant.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or intermediate output showing the subtraction of congruent means from incongruent means.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the overall group mean interference score across all non-excluded participants.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A final calculation step showing the average of the individual interference scores.

task_completion.description: The agent writes the final JSON report to ~/pebl/analysis/flanker_report.json with all required keys.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or editor view showing the saved JSON file containing 'participants' (with id, interference_score_ms, mean_rt_congruent_ms, etc.) and 'group_mean_interference_ms'.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply write a pre-determined JSON file without performing data analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must be seen writing code (Python, R, etc.) or using a spreadsheet tool to process the CSV data before generating the JSON.

integrity.description: The agent used the GUI environment (file explorer, code editor, or IDE) rather than just executing hidden background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent interacting with windows, clicking buttons, or typing in an visible editor/terminal.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the specific file path mentioned in the prompt.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path ~/pebl/data/flanker_rt_data.csv is visible in the agent's workspace or command history.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The interference score must be (Mean Incongruent RT - Mean Congruent RT). Participants marked as 'excluded': true must have a 'reason' string. The 'group_mean_interference_ms' must only include data from participants where 'excluded' is not true.
